name: zed
notes: Requires GIT_CRATES and WEBRTC_COMMIT checks on every bump. See update_zed_editor.md.

name: carla
notes: Standard GitHub release. Upgrade workflow proven end-to-end.

name: surgext
notes: Non-standard tag pattern. Stable releases are tags only (no GitHub Release objects). Requires source repackaging with submodules via repackage-surge.yml before ebuild can fetch sources.

name: yabridge
notes: Current ebuild (5.1.2-r1) tracks upstream master by commit SHA until a stable release newer than 5.1.1 is tagged. Version checking against release tags will lag behind the actual ebuild state until that happens.

name: amp-locker
notes: Downloads from Audio Assault S3 bucket. No public release API available. Updates must be checked manually at https://audioassault.mx/amplocker.php

name: drum-locker
notes: Downloads from Audio Assault S3 bucket. No public release API available. Updates must be checked manually at https://audioassault.mx/drumlocker.php

name: bitwig-studio
notes: Downloads directly from bitwig.com. No public release API. Updates must be checked manually at https://www.bitwig.com/download/. Use --version to trigger upgrade-ebuild.sh manually. Version strings can be 2-component (6.0) or 3-component (5.3.13). Verify download URL returns HTTP 302 before upgrading.

name: forticlient
notes: Downloads from Fortinet's apt repo. No public release API. Updates must be checked manually at https://www.fortinet.com/support/product-downloads

name: openfortivpn
notes: Open-source Fortinet compatible VPN client. Upstream releases are git tags.

name: hermes-agent
notes: Uses CalVer tags (e.g. v2026.9.7).

name: ai-voice-server
notes: Self-hosted voice dictation pipeline. Maintained as a live 9999 ebuild.

name: firecrawl-anydoc
notes: Python/Rust maturin package.

name: ddgs
notes: DuckDuckGo and multi-backend metasearch library; depends on primp and lxml.

name: discord-py
notes: Python wrapper for the Discord API.

name: mcp
notes: Model Context Protocol SDK; version-matched mcp-types is a required dependency.

name: mcp-types
notes: Wire-types subpackage released with the MCP SDK; keep version in lockstep.

name: primp
notes: Maturin/Rust extension; update the CRATES list and Rust minimum on bumps.

name: sse-starlette
notes: Server-Sent Events implementation used by the MCP SDK HTTP server transports.

name: openai
notes: Official OpenAI Python client library.

name: jiter
notes: Fast iterable JSON parser. Maturin/Cargo build requiring CRATES updates.

name: fire
notes: Python library for automatically generating command line interfaces.

name: aivoice
notes: Gentoo system group for ai-voice-server.

name: aivoice
notes: Gentoo system user for ai-voice-server.

name: hermesagent
notes: Gentoo system group for hermes-agent daemon.

name: hermesagent
notes: Gentoo system user for hermes-agent daemon.

name: cua-driver
notes: trycua/cua monorepo; every cua-driver release is marked prerelease, so upstream_type github-prerelease. Pattern excludes nightly-* tags. On bump: regenerate CRATES with pycargoebuild on crates/cua-driver + crates/cursor-theme-cli, re-apply files/cua-driver-*-portage-managed.patch, check the wayland-helper extension version.
